name: Kiwi Pocket
tagline: Read-only view of NZ bank accounts for spending, bills and budgeting.
description: Connects to New Zealand bank accounts through your own free Akahu app, and the connection reads only: money never moves and nothing can be paid from it. On that live view it follows where spending goes, keeps upcoming bills on schedule, and helps shape a budget that reflects what is really happening in the account.
author: daimenhutchison
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
